title: Haray Masalay Wali Machhli (Fish in Green Curry)

source.text: S. Abbas Raza, Pakistani & North Indian Cooking (2015)

description: A delicate, subtle fish curry that looks as good as it tastes, from Robin Varghese, slightly modified by the author.

items: 2 cu in ginger (2 × 3 × 5 cm), in 3 pieces

steps.action: Heat in a large pot over high, 2 min:
Reduce to medium-high (7/10); pour in slowly:
Add and cook 5 min, stirring often:
items: 2 tsp salt (1½ tsp if the cashews are salted)

steps.action: Add, stir, and bring to a boil:
Turn to high; add, stir gently, and return to a boil:
items: 1¾ lb white fish (800 g; halibut, cod, striped bass, haddock), rinsed in cold water, in about 1 in (2.5 cm) pieces

steps.action: Cover; simmer on medium-low (3/10) 10 min. Turn off heat and rest covered 5 min.
